notes: Verified live on the HF Hub and github.com/octo-models/octo @ 241fb35 on 2026-10-01; see 14-10-SUMMARY.md and checkpoint_candidates.md (backend:octo).

action_space was read from each checkpoint's own dataset_statistics.json (7-D, mask [T]*6+[F], cm/0.1-rad magnitudes) and, for the default, the RLDS dataset card (ivlabs/so101_pick_cube_v2_merged_rlds_3hz: action/eef_delta_m_rad, Pinocchio FK on the SO101 URDF, gripper min-max over [-10, 100]). It is not assumed from the Octo family.
--checkpoint must match the checkpoint octo_server.py was launched with: it selects the gripper mapping. Each step's model_version shows what the server ran.

Default sapanostic/octo-so101-3hz-finetune: a real SO-101 fine-tune of octo-base-1.5 (window 2, horizon 4, primary + wrist, trained at 3 Hz). It has no model card and no license, and its so101_dataset_transform is unpublished.

rail-berkeley/octo-{small,base}-1.5 (MIT, official): OXE-pretrained, un-normalized with the bridge_dataset (WidowX, 5 Hz) statistics. These are out of distribution on SO-101 hardware, with an identity WidowX->SO-101 frame mapping.
